checks_reported_in_pull_requests: #58: 77 service answers recorded live on 2026-11-15 (the five R05 targets by name and at their fields.toml positions, an empty-sky point, GJ 699, 3C 273, the M87 core and a click 5.5 arcsec from R Dra) are replayed offline by the tests; the object-context network tests passed 5 of 5 in two runs

#93: the rebuilt products validate as LightCurveProduct; R Dra 259.09 -> 261.88 d from LC27 (delta chi2 0.3, within the error), bootstrap 242.0-274.4 d, still significant (1/101); the RW Aur curve is unchanged and the ensemble changed for 4 of its 8 pairs

#101: the two Gaia DR3 sources of RW Aur lie 1.493 arcsec apart at PA 254.4 deg, matching WDS 05078+3024 JOY 5 (A to BC 1.50 arcsec at PA 254 deg, 2022), so 156430817820015232 is A and 156430822114424576 is B, the reverse of SIMBAD's cross-identification
integration_validation.checks_basis: Run with AI assistance and reported in the pull request bodies, docs/SCIENCE.md and the docstring of test_science_validation_network.py; not independently verified by a human. The network tests are skipped unless ERRANTE_NETWORK_TESTS=1, so CI does not run them

cache_revision: WS3 keeps no versioned product cache of its own: context.py keeps the raw catalog answers on disk with a TTL (ERRANTE_CONTEXT_CACHE_TTL_S, 7 days by default) and serves expired entries marked stale when a service fails. WS4's light-curve processing identity (backend/errante_api/lightcurve_build.py processing_identity) hashes every pipeline/errante/science/*.py module, so WS3 code changes change that fingerprint; WS4's general source_fingerprint (backend/errante_api/processing.py) does not include science/. This JSON record is not a .py file and changes neither
